description: Source code for the PdfType1Font class in the PDFsharp library, representing a Type 1 font in PDF documents. Contains class definition, nested Keys class for font dictionary keys, and related metadata.

classes.name: PdfType1Font
classes.description: Represents a Type 1 font in a PDF document, inheriting from PdfFont. Not fully implemented, mainly for illustration.

classes.name: PdfType1Font.Keys
classes.description: Contains predefined keys for the font dictionary, such as Type, Subtype, BaseFont, FirstChar, LastChar, Widths, FontDescriptor, Encoding, and ToUnicode.

methods.name: PdfType1Font
methods.description: Constructor initializing the font with a PDF document and setting type/subtype elements.

methods.name: Meta
methods.description: Property returning the metadata for the font dictionary keys.
